description: This source file defines a Kotlin class 'NotificationPermissionHandler' that manages notification permission checks and requests within an Android application. It handles runtime permission requests for posting notifications, particularly considering different SDK versions.

classes.name: NotificationPermissionHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing notification permission checks and requests in an Android app.

methods.name: checkNotificationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the notification permission has been granted. If not, it may request permission depending on the SDK version and rationale.

methods.name: requestNotificationPermission
methods.description: Requests the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission at runtime for SDK versions that require it.
